summary: Metals Royalty Co Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting its entry into a royalty purchase agreement via subsidiary TMCR USA Operations Inc. to acquire a portion of Ironclad Royalties' interest in a gross production revenue royalty on Mesabi Metallics' iron ore project in Nashwauk, Minnesota. The purchase price is $132.5 million, comprising $125M cash and $7.5M in common shares issued in a private placement under Section 4(a)(2). An option exists to purchase an additional royalty interest for same terms, expiring at closing. A non-refundable $15M deposit was paid. Closing is subject to conditions; no break fee or expected close date stated. Watch for regulatory clearance and project production milestones.
